summary_rationale: Coforge is a high-execution, domain-led mid-tier Indian IT and digital engineering compounder that grew revenue from ₹2,372 Cr (FY15) to ₹16,403 Cr (FY26) and ₹20,380 Cr TTM (Sep 2026) while maintaining 23.5% ROCE, 21.4% ROE, and a CRISIL AA+/Stable rating on ₹6,148.2 Cr of bank facilities. Under CEO Sudhir Singh, it lifted Cigniti EBITDA margins from ~11% to ~19%, expanded its 12-month executable order book to $2.38B (+45% YoY) with $1.04B Q2 FY27 TCV, 16.0% EBIT margin, 10.4% attrition, and 82.4% utilization, and expanded its Nuuron agentic cybersecurity platform (Nov 25, 2026). However, kpi_health remains PASS_WITH_WATCH because: (1) post-Encora borrowings jumped to ₹6,026 Cr and fixed/intangibles to ₹23,592 Cr (67.8% of assets) alongside ~21.8% equity dilution to Advent International and Warburg Pincus; (2) Q2 FY27 Total DSO stretched +8 days QoQ to 110 days (net unbilled revenue up from ₹2,100 Cr to ₹2,600 Cr) during Encora entity novation, even as H1 FY27 FCF/PAT reached 92%; (3) Encora standalone revenue was flat QoQ (~$147–148M) in Q2 FY27 and legacy FX hedge losses ($10.2M in Q2) taper to zero only in FY28; and (4) Chairman O.P. Bhatt and NRC Chair D.K. Singh abruptly resigned in Sep 2026 over board-evaluation disclosure gaps, leaving an interim chair through Jan 31, 2027.
